All twelve invited."},{"spec_id":"spec_0519","text":"Kestrel initiative: freezer excursion postmortem (Bldg 2, Rm 114, 60 min, 13 invited) — sorry for the short notice, and sorry for pulling everyone in on this, please bring whatever you have"},{"spec_id":"spec_0520","text":"Hiring Sync — Quarry migration support role
45 min | Cyrus, Sana Whitcombe, Bruno Jaramillo, Hiroshi Fitzgerald

Purpose: get on the same page. Again.

1. Status of the posting
- Posting has been live since the 3rd. As a reminder, I sent the final description on the 1st, and it's the version that went out.
* Applicant count: 14 (Sana to confirm, since apparently the HR portal is only visible to some of us)

2. Screening
- Rubric was attached to my email last Tuesday. If you didn't see it, it's still there.
-Each of us takes a share of applicants; I've already split them alphabetically, see attached

3. Interview panel availability
* Please put your availability in the shared calendar. Ideally before the meeting, so we don't spend the meeting doing that.
- Target first-round interviews week of the 21st

4. Timeline to offer
- District board needs a name by end of month for the Quarry migration budget line. This hasn't changed.

---
Replies:
> Sana: 14 confirmed, 3 are internal transfers fyi
> Bruno: got the rubric, sorry, it went to my junk folder. Do we need to meet if the split is already done?
> Hiroshi: calendar updated. Fine either way
> Cyrus: I'd rather we meet so nobody can say they weren't told.

Location: District Office, Room B / Teams link below"}]}
